label: Cell width proportion
description: Fit-relative cell proportions; the map remains aligned to its logical grid and constrained to available space.

label: Cell height proportion
description: Fit-relative cell proportions; the map remains aligned to its logical grid and constrained to available space.

label: Sidebar maximum width (px)
description: Maximum width in pixels of the persistent right sidebar. The floor keeps the remaining width.

label: Sidebar screen width (%)
description: Fixed percentage of window width, bounded by the sidebar maximum. Only resizing or deliberate editing changes it.

label: Resource region height (px)
description: Fixed height reserved for resources and conditions. Extra conditions scroll inside their reserved space.

label: Chronicle height (px)
description: Fixed narration region height; default shows four and a half lines. History never grows this region.

label: Ability row height
description: Constant row height. Excess abilities use the separate management menu; acquiring abilities never shrinks rows.

label: Inventory row height
description: Fixed item row height inside the twenty-slot Pack. Larger authored rows scroll within the same window.
